- [IRET.1.2] **No runtime text parsing.** The Rete
  network topology and all expression trees arrive in
  binary form, as the artefact's `AlphaNode`, `BetaNode` and
  `TerminalNode` atoms ([RDSC.4a]). The loader
  assembles in-memory node graphs from that description;
  no textual rule language is parsed at runtime.
